after that you will be asked for your conclusion.

and, if so, its root cause. Do not change anything in the cluster.

own line: {"incident": true or false, "component": "<kind>/<name> of the root cause, or null",
"summary": "<one or two sentences>"}. Name the component as the Kubernetes object at fault (for
example deployment/payment, service/cart, node/<node name>); for one of the shop's feature flags,
use flag/<flag name>.

Accounting 3.2.0 (Recreate strategy, so the old pod is gone) adds an init container that polls the Kubernetes API until Job `ledger-migrate-7` is Complete. The Job's `migrate` container did its work in seconds ("ledger migration 7 applied") and exited 0, but the pod also runs a `log-shipper` as a regular container that loops forever. A pod completes only when all its regular containers have exited, so the Job stays Running at 0/1 completions, the new accounting pod never leaves initialization, the orders consumer group has no members, and orders pile up in Kafka unrecorded while checkout keeps working.
